claims.claim: B has a screen near the steering wheel in B's vehicle
claims.attribute: B has a screen located near the steering wheel in B's vehicle

evidence.quote: the screen near your steering wheel

claims.adjudication_reason: Definite description 'the screen near your steering wheel' presupposes existence of a screen near B's steering wheel.

claims.claim: B has a steering wheel (implying B has a vehicle)
claims.attribute: B has a steering wheel, implying ownership of a vehicle
claims.adjudication_reason: Possessive 'your steering wheel' presupposes B has a steering wheel (and thus a vehicle).

claims.claim: B's screen/TV is on every day
claims.attribute: B's screen is on every day
claims.adjudication_reason: Question 'what's on everyday' presupposes the screen/TV is on every day; the question asks about content, not whether it is on.

claims.claim: B has a TV (the screen is referred to as a TV)
claims.attribute: B has a TV in the vehicle

evidence.quote: Are there any commercials on the TV

claims.adjudication_reason: A uses definite 'the TV' referring back to the screen; this is A's labeling of the screen as a TV, a presupposition from context.

claims.claim: B has passengers in B's vehicle
claims.attribute: B has passengers in B's vehicle
claims.adjudication_reason: Definite possessive 'your passengers' presupposes B has passengers.

claims.claim: A is one of B's passengers
claims.attribute: A is riding as a passenger in B's vehicle
claims.adjudication_reason: 'your passengers like me' explicitly states A is one of B's passengers via coreference.

claims.claim: The TV can entertain B's passengers
claims.attribute: B's TV has the capability to entertain passengers

evidence.quote: It can also entertain your passengers like me

claims.adjudication_reason: Explicit statement: 'It can also entertain your passengers like me' – A asserts the TV's capability.

claims.claim: A is a passenger in B's vehicle
claims.attribute: A is riding as a passenger in B's vehicle

evidence.quote: It can also entertain your passengers like me

claims.adjudication_reason: A explicitly states 'your passengers like me' in turn 15, directly presupposing A's role as a passenger in B's vehicle. This is a solid E2 presupposition from A's own words.
